# möbius for macOS 0.10.28

Each chat now keeps its own open tabs and selected document. Switching chats restores their files, changes, terminals and browser tabs, while late file results stay with the chat that opened them.

Loading older turns preserves your reading position, including when new output arrives at the same time. The composer has clear side margins, and sidebar rows fade softly beneath New Chat while scrolling.

Chat-loading failures show the connection error without a misleading message-delivery warning. Messages awaiting delivery confirmation retain their existing protection against duplicate sends.

Bundles gateway 0.16.46. Protocol 97 and stored-state formats are unchanged.
